== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 10 January 2023. The Facebook photo viewer names Dean DeGrazia. Comments on the photograph address him as Dean. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 82 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Pittsburgh, Pa). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/dbdegrazia. The uncropped original is a four-person photograph; the lead crop is DeGrazia alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Dean DeGrazia portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Dean DeGrazia Facebook portrait.jpg]].
